sourceConflictNote: The revised EPS calendar is inconsistent. Page 1 starts the third quarter on January 4 and totals 172 instructional days; page 2 starts it on January 5 and totals 171. The January grid does not mark January 4 as a closure. Until EPS clarifies the discrepancy, this page treats the return date and instructional-day total as unconfirmed and leaves the return date out of the ICS. A smaller office-status discrepancy appears at Thanksgiving: page 2 says offices are open November 24–25, while page 1 appears to mark November 25 as closed.

customSections.label: How Weather Can Change the Edmond Calendar
customSections.content: EPS may switch to remote learning or announce a non-instruction day after checking roads, temperatures and precipitation. Lost instructional time can extend school beyond May 19. The district generally avoids early dismissal, and a tornado warning at dismissal can hold students and buses until the all-clear.
